description: This file defines TypeScript types related to MCP (Model Cloud Protocol) tools and session management for an agent framework, including runtime and catalog structures, and interfaces for managing sessions and tool invocation.

methods.name: getCatalog
methods.description: Retrieves the catalog of MCP tools asynchronously.

methods.name: callTool
methods.description: Calls a specific tool on a server with provided input and returns the result.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the runtime or session.

methods.name: getOrCreate
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an existing session runtime based on provided parameters.

methods.name: bindSessionKey
methods.description: Associates a session key with a session ID.

methods.name: resolveSessionId
methods.description: Resolves a session key to its corresponding session ID.

methods.name: disposeSession
methods.description: Disposes of a specific session by ID.

methods.name: listSessionIds
methods.description: Returns an array of all current session IDs.
